bullets: Reproducible inhibition in the confirmatory run for the most strongly basic side chain

slides.title: hERG IC50 by compound (first 12)

slides.title: Geometric mean IC50 per compound
slides.notes: Censored entries are lower bounds at the top tested concentration, not finite IC50 measurements; consult the compound table when comparing bars.

slides.title: Control acceptance
bullets: E-4031 reference gave a control IC50 of {{PRJ0037:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM, within the protocol acceptance window
Compound IC50 is the geometric mean of finite cell estimates only when finite estimates are the majority of accepted cells
Otherwise the compound estimate is censored at the applicable tested limit
{{PRJ0037:herg.n_censored}} compound estimates are censored; cell counts and qualifications remain in the table
slides.notes: Check the censored estimate footnote wording against the released table, not against this slide.

slides.title: Chemistry read-across
bullets: Feldorune dropped the most strongly basic side chain after reproducible hERG inhibition in the confirmatory run
This supports the chemistry selection decision; the table alone does not establish side-chain causality
bullets_right: Other members of the screening set also inhibit hERG
Keep the screening decision separate from a mechanistic or clinical safety claim
